title: Shared inheritance reveals landscape of somatic and germline cancer risk in TP53.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: no PMCID, no open full text, no supplement, no accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. Read the medRxiv preprint (10.64898/2026.04.10.26350605) data availability statement via WebFetch.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 469,391 UK Biobank (UKB) exomes; 1,753 nonsynonymous TP53 variants, 315 pathogenic/likely pathogenic listed in Supplementary Table 1; individual-level data only via approved UKB access; code at github.com/the-blundell-lab/SomaticGermlineTP53Risk.

a1_downloadable.note: Preprint states individual-level data (exomes, VAF (variant allele fraction), haplotypes) is available only to approved UK Biobank researchers on its Research Analysis Platform: controlled access. Checked statement in preprint only.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The somatic-vs-germline call is constructed by the authors from VAF plus haplotype sharing; it is not a measured column.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs (per-carrier VAF, haplotypes) live only inside UKB; not checked.

a5_enough_rows.note: Public per-variant table, if any, would cover about 315 pathogenic variants (paper text); not verified and below threshold.

a8_label_provenance.note: Somatic/germline label is inferred by the authors' VAF and haplotype method, not a direct measurement.

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: the data is controlled-access UK Biobank.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a TP53 variant's protein change and functional scores to predict how often it appears as blood-only acquired mutation versus inherited.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-variant features of TP53 changes (position, amino-acid change, lab functional assay scores); number of examples unknown, about 315 pathogenic variants per paper text.
plain_idea.predict: The fraction of carriers whose variant is somatic (acquired in blood) rather than germline (inherited), inferred by the authors from allele fraction and shared haplotypes in UK Biobank.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Genetic counsellors interpreting TP53 hits in blood tests would know which variants are likely clonal expansions, not Li-Fraumeni syndrome.

ml_idea: Predict per-variant somatic fraction from functional scores; infeasible without UK Biobank access.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; data is controlled access.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Data availability statement: UK Biobank approval required (already fails).

verdict_reason: A1 fails: all individual-level data is UK Biobank controlled access (application required); the somatic/germline label is also constructed by the authors' method (A2/A8), and any public per-variant table would be about 315 rows.
